display_name: LoRa W24 跨 chirp 复数谱校正（Full 源域）
description: Compare matched ridge correction of nine-to-32 signed spectral bins from a frozen native W24 DURA parent. Screen whether off-diagonal chirp covariance improves Full practical identification.
authorization: Active LoRa DURA W24 goal, lawful source U_s same-waveform paired IQ, frozen W24 only after added source coefficients freeze, Full route.

code.environment: Archived N607 CVS-RFFI with exact registered W24 release

data.representation: Native 8192 complex samples; class scores use W24 8×2×432.
data.contract_ref: Pinned LoRa full packet native IQ contract
data.physical_ids_ref: Same 300 unique opaque source V packet IDs as frozen outer-objective source run
data.validation_ref: Native source contract 392005; disjoint 1024 U_s fit and 128 waveform holdout, frozen 300 source V IDs and archived direct/outer parity.
data.leo_config_ref: Full native practical and clean. Prediction uses generated receive IQ.

permissions.claim_scope: Source calibration and source screen. No F/TX/V/target access at fit or freeze. DURA and W24 checkpoints read only for their allowed roles.

checkpoint.initialization: Frozen 40k outer G. New complex coefficients solved from zero regularized sufficient statistics.
checkpoint.contract_check_ref: Source frozen checkpoint binding and actual paired blind decisions must match the immutable prior source run.
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: Contract-bound LoRa U_s frozen parent; U_s IQ only for new coefficients. W24 for frozen source inference.
checkpoint.selection_rule: One fixed ridge solve with no candidate or hyperparameter selection. Separate preregistered Full target promotion requires cross_chirp >= parent+18 six and parent+10 low, clean >= direct and positive six/low over independent.

execution.gpu_policy: One GPU, 7 then 3, 6, 0, at least 12 GiB free and existing process cap; 8 CPU workers.
execution.stop_rule: Stop on source/parent binding, invalid finite fit, smoke, physical ID or archived decisions, missing predictions or truth-last failure.

metrics_plan.scorer_ref: experiments.pamf_lora_main.w24_spectral_cov score-source through the existing frozen Full source scorer

rows.method: Direct, frozen outer half, same-band real-observation+parent-edit ridge with per-chirp blocks, and dense cross-chirp ridge. No F during fit. Fixed lambda .05 of mean band design power, each extra norm capped at half the parent edit.
rows.seed_notes: No training/model seed or support. The 300 source V panel and waveform namespace are reused. Evaluation seed identifies W24 E104.
rows.budget_ref: 1024 U_s fits each with one generic paired observation and one identity. 128 disjoint U_s waveform holdout. Frozen 300 source V packets x seven views.

notes: Live capacity must permit one run-owned fit/prediction worker. GPU and code are independently verified.
Both arms consume the same spectra, split, ridge, actual half correction, output cap and clean pairs. Only full versus chirp-block covariance and fit differ.
Band support in tracked center: signed |k| 9–32. Packet normalization and apply-time gate use measured center and parent edit norms only.
Source-free CPU checks covered conjugate orientation, spectral support, zero edit, model scale equivariance and matched masks; one independent P0/P1 review passed.
No new Residual. Candidate uncertainty recorded with receiver-stratified physical-packet bootstrap.
